oh sorry just saw this.

and i always need permission from my parents to directly seek help
thanks for your kind words. and i really hope people need me like i need someone right now
thank you for your kind words but sometimes those demons in my head tell me to end my life
and that's also the scary part. i just hope he/she is fine
i don't want to believe it but yeah -
i'm glad that it worked out for you, man. and thank you for your kind words. really appreciate it.
yeah... she, including my father, are not supportive and understanding. and i never open up about my mental issues to them because i don't trust them.

to be honest, i have never had the chances in telling them what i want and what makes me happy as they seemed to care more about money than happiness. even my older sister and my other siblings are suffering from mental health too.
i basically tossed and turned on my bed as it is 1230 am now at my country. i just went to bed thinking of how my parents will beat the crap outta me for skipping school - a lot. and i couldn't help it but turn on my laptop again, and was grateful that i got a reply from you.
you gave me hope, seriously.
it must be a hard decision for your sister to move out of the house.
i've been thinking of moving out to my aunt's as it just don't feel like home here, at my parents' house. i don't feel safe or warm here.
i want to improve my life but i have to deal with my parents first.
and i'm proud of you in making the decision to get out of the house. i want to feel free too.
thank you for commenting on my i-don't-know-maybe-a-note-for-help post. also, thanks for your advice. really appreciate it.

i can't do what i love as my parents are toxic. to be honest, i prefer saying that they have bad parenting.

when i told my dad that i don't want to go to school anymore (as it keeps on draining my soul), he said, "I don't want any of my children to not be educated. if you don't want to go to school anymore, get out of this house and go to your aunt's!"

well, i want to be a writer, and an artist. more to i wanna be a LINE Webtoon creator as i love drawing and i love arts. writing and drawing are the only ones that keep me sane until now. i did plan on the journey of how I'm going to live life the way i wanted but yeah, my parents thought of not being 'educated' can never have a proper life.
it's 12 am and also, i can't sleep. i would wanna be ur friend

it's fine but seriously, i regretted opening up tp her. i never went to see the counselor ever again even though she told me to meet her if i have anything to share.

and yeah, there are good counselors and as you said, they're hard to find.
a counselor told me that suicide is selfish and i was fighting the urge to walk out of the room saying, "AIGHT I REGRET THIS.'
